```yaml
name: Tag Report

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  tag-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.18'

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Generate coverage report
        run: |
          go install github.com/go-test-cover/testcover@latest
          testcover -html=coverage.out -output=coverage.html

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-go
          files: ./coverage.html
          fail_ci_if_error: true

      - name: Create release report
        id: create_report
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=report::\"🎉 Release v0.9.1\\n\\n**Version**: v0.9.1\\n**Type**: Patch (Bug Fix + Enhancement)\\n**Date**: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)\\n\\n### ✨ What's New\\n\\n#### Features\\n- **Automatic UV Tool Cache Refresh** (SPEC-UPDATE-CACHE-FIX-001)\\n  - Auto-detects stale PyPI metadata\\n  - Seamlessly retries upgrade after cache clear\\n  - Users no longer need to run upgrade twice\\n\\n#### Bug Fixes\\n- Fixed double-run issue in \`uv tool upgrade moai-adk\`\\n- Python 3.13 CI/CD workflow compatibility\\n\\n#### Documentation\\n- Added troubleshooting guide (README)\\n- Release notes in CHANGELOG\\n- Complete SPEC documentation\\n\\n### 📊 Quality Metrics\\n- ✅ Tests: 572 passing\\n- ✅ Coverage: 56.76%\\n- ✅ Type Check: Passed\\n- ✅ Security: No vulns\\n- ✅ TAGs: 13 verified (100% integrity)\\n\\n### 📦 Installation\\n [code omitted] \\n\\n**Note**: This PR uses squash merge to maintain clean main branch history.\""

      - name: Post release report
        if: github.ref_type == 'tag'
        run: echo "${{ steps.create_report.outputs.report }}"
```
